caption:
Same position all day, and by dinner time Mr Turtle's back feels tight and achy.

After hours of sitting, standing or driving in similar positions, that evening stiffness is often your body asking for a change of position rather than a sign of harm.

Change position every 30 to 45 minutes: stand for calls, refill your water, take the stairs. In the evening, try knee rocks, cat-cow and a short walk after dinner.

Leg numbness or weakness, bladder or bowel changes, fever or unexplained weight loss need prompt medical review. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio assess how your back moves and may use hands-on care alongside exercise and habit changes. Book online via the link in bio 🐢

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
